msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional male fashion model (a man). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia modas-ilusion-17.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish man in his thirties wearing a brown three-piece suit with a beige waistcoat, a white shirt and a brown tie from the reference, walking at a sunny street in the centre of Pizarra, Málaga, Spain, with whitewashed houses, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia modas-ilusion-24.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a rust brown two-piece suit with a light blue shirt and a brown tie from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia modas-ilusion-01.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a brown check tweed blazer with a light blue shirt and white jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia modas-ilusion-13.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a burgundy and cream half-zip knit sweater from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
